title_en: New roll-on, roll-off ferry serving Pengkalan Kubor - Takbai, Thailand to start March
summary_en: LUMUT: The new RM8mil ferry Sri Tanjong I is expected to start operations at the Public Works Department (PWD) Jetty in Pengkalan Kubor, Kelantan this March. Deputy Works Minister Datuk Seri Ahmad Faizal Azumu said that the ship will be ready for operation by the end of May and it will be delivered to Malaysian ports on July 15th.
